description: PostHog product analytics for the us.posthog.com / eu.posthog.com tab you are already logged into — 38 tools covering dashboards, insights, feature flags, experiments, annotations, persons, cohorts, surveys, actions, projects, HogQL and trends queries, raw events and event/property definitions. Same-origin /api/environments/<team>/... and /api/projects/<team>/... calls with the tab's session cookie and the posthog_csrftoken CSRF header.

tools.name: create_annotation
tools.description: Create a new annotation to mark an important event on PostHog charts.

tools.name: create_dashboard
tools.description: Create a new dashboard in the current PostHog project.

tools.name: create_experiment
tools.description: Create a new A/B test experiment. Requires a name and feature flag key.

tools.name: create_feature_flag
tools.description: Create a new boolean feature flag. The key must be unique within the project and is used in code to check the flag.

tools.name: create_insight
tools.description: Create a new saved insight in the current PostHog project. Provide a HogQL query string and the insight will be created as a HogQL visualization. Optionally specify a name, description, and dashboard to add it to.

tools.name: delete_annotation
tools.description: Delete an annotation by marking it as deleted (soft delete).

tools.name: delete_dashboard
tools.description: Delete a dashboard by marking it as deleted (soft delete). The dashboard can potentially be recovered.

tools.name: delete_feature_flag
tools.description: Delete a feature flag by marking it as deleted (soft delete).

tools.name: delete_insight
tools.description: Delete an insight by marking it as deleted (soft delete).

tools.name: get_action
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific action including its tags and calculation status.

tools.name: get_cohort
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific cohort including its person count and calculation status.

tools.name: get_current_user
tools.description: Get the profile of the currently authenticated PostHog user including email, name, and organization details.

tools.name: get_dashboard
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific dashboard including its tiles and sharing status.

tools.name: get_experiment
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific experiment including its dates and feature flag key.

tools.name: get_feature_flag
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific feature flag including its key, rollout configuration, and tags.

tools.name: get_insight
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific insight including its query configuration and dashboard associations.

tools.name: get_organization
tools.description: Get details about the current PostHog organization including name and membership level.

tools.name: get_person
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific person including their properties and distinct IDs.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific PostHog project by its ID.

tools.name: get_survey
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific survey including its type, dates, and archive status.

tools.name: list_actions
tools.description: List actions in the current PostHog project. Actions are groups of events defined by matching rules.

tools.name: list_annotations
tools.description: List annotations in the current PostHog project. Annotations mark important events on charts.

tools.name: list_cohorts
tools.description: List cohorts in the current PostHog project. Cohorts are groups of persons defined by shared properties or behaviors.

tools.name: list_dashboards
tools.description: List all dashboards in the current PostHog project. Returns dashboard names, tags, and tile counts.

tools.name: list_event_definitions
tools.description: List all event types that have been sent to the current PostHog project. Returns event names with 30-day volume and last-seen timestamps. Useful for discovering what events are being tracked before querying them.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List raw events from the current PostHog project. Returns individual event occurrences with their properties. Filter by event name, person distinct ID, or date range. Events are ordered by timestamp descending (newest first).

tools.name: list_experiments
tools.description: List A/B test experiments in the current PostHog project.

tools.name: list_feature_flags
tools.description: List feature flags in the current PostHog project. Supports filtering by active status and search query.

tools.name: list_insights
tools.description: List insights (trends, funnels, retention, paths, etc.) in the current PostHog project. Insights are the core analytics visualizations.

tools.name: list_persons
tools.description: List persons (users) tracked in the current PostHog project. Supports search by name, email, or distinct ID.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List all projects in the current PostHog organization. Projects contain events, dashboards, feature flags, and other analytics data.

tools.name: list_property_definitions
tools.description: List all property definitions (event properties, person properties, or group properties) in the current PostHog project. Returns property names and types. Use type filter to scope: "event" for event properties, "person" for person properties.

tools.name: list_surveys
tools.description: List surveys in the current PostHog project. Surveys collect user feedback via popover, button, email, or API.

tools.name: run_query
tools.description: Execute a HogQL (SQL-like) query against PostHog event data. HogQL supports SELECT, aggregations (count, uniqExact, avg, sum, min, max), GROUP BY, ORDER BY, WHERE, and JOIN. Query the `events` table for raw events, `persons` for person data. Example: "SELECT event, count() as total FROM events WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY event ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 20".

tools.name: run_trends_query
tools.description: Run a time series trends query over events. Returns data points per interval (day, week, month, hour). Supports multiple series, math aggregations (total, unique users, average, sum, min, max), and breakdowns by property. Easier to use than raw HogQL for standard time series charts.

tools.name: update_dashboard
tools.description: Update an existing dashboard. Only specified fields are changed; omitted fields remain unchanged.

tools.name: update_feature_flag
tools.description: Update an existing feature flag. Only specified fields are changed; omitted fields remain unchanged.

tools.name: update_insight
tools.description: Update an existing insight. Only specified fields are changed; omitted fields remain unchanged.
